A premium sedan with a powerful presence
The 2016 Kia Cadenza is a premium sedan that commands attention, artfully combining sophisticated
exterior styling, a luxurious interior, and exhilarating performance. Its many technologically advanced
available features include Advanced Smart Cruise Control,1* Blind-Spot Detection with Lane-Change Assist,1*
and Lane Departure Warning System.1* A 293-hp, 3.3L Gasoline Direct Injection (GDI) V6 engine delivers
exceptional performance, while its finely tuned suspension system provides a smooth, quiet ride and
precise handling. In addition, the 2015 Cadenza was honored with the prestigious AutoPacific® ”Best in Class
Vehicle Satisfaction — Large Car”2 award, a measurement of owner satisfaction with everything from
performance to interior comfort and convenience. Like all Kia models, Cadenza comes with an industry-
leading, 10-year/100,000-mile warranty program3 — a reflection of its outstanding quality and reliability.

Responsive and exciting performance
Cadenza delivers exhilarating performance and precise handling. A 3.3L Gasoline Direct Injection (GDI) V6
engine generates 293 horsepower for dynamic acceleration. Its 6-speed, Sportmatic® transmission allows
you to choose between automatic mode or, for sportier driving, clutch-free manual shifting with available
steering-wheel-mounted4 paddle shifters.* To ensure a remarkably smooth and quiet ride, Cadenza features
a finely tuned suspension system, along with sound-absorbing insulation that reduces and absorbs road noise.
